dataset.name: Checkup dataset
dataset.description: 100,000 anonymised checkup records with lifestyle, lab and diabetes outcome data.

sections.label: Lifestyle
sections.description: Daily habits: activity, diet, sleep, screens, alcohol and smoking.

sections.label: Heart & blood pressure
sections.description: Blood pressure and resting heart rate.

sections.label: Cholesterol & lipids
sections.description: Blood fats measured in the lipid panel.

sections.label: Diabetes outcomes
sections.description: Diagnosis, stage and the dataset's risk score.

age.label: Age
age.description: Age in years at the checkup.

smoking_status.label: Smoking
smoking_status.description: Whether the person has never smoked, used to smoke or smokes now.

physical_activity_minutes_per_week.label: Physical activity
physical_activity_minutes_per_week.description: Minutes of physical activity per week. The WHO recommends at least 150 minutes of moderate activity.

diet_score.label: Diet quality score
diet_score.description: Diet quality on the dataset's 0–10 scale. Higher means a healthier diet.

sleep_hours_per_day.label: Sleep
sleep_hours_per_day.description: Average hours of sleep per day. Adults are advised to get 7–9 hours.

screen_time_hours_per_day.label: Screen time
screen_time_hours_per_day.description: Average hours per day spent on screens.

family_history_diabetes.label: Family history of diabetes
family_history_diabetes.description: Whether a close family member has diabetes.

hypertension_history.label: History of hypertension
hypertension_history.description: Whether the person has been diagnosed with high blood pressure.

cardiovascular_history.label: Cardiovascular history
cardiovascular_history.description: Whether the person has a history of heart or blood-vessel disease.

bmi.label: BMI
bmi.description: Weight relative to height. Under 18.5 is underweight, 18.5–24.9 healthy, 25–29.9 overweight and 30 or above obesity (WHO).

waist_to_hip_ratio.label: Waist-to-hip ratio
waist_to_hip_ratio.description: Waist circumference divided by hip circumference. The WHO treats 0.90 or more in men and 0.85 or more in women as abdominal obesity.

systolic_bp.label: Systolic blood pressure
systolic_bp.description: The top blood-pressure number, measured while the heart beats. Under 120 is normal, 120–129 elevated, 130–139 stage 1 and 140 or above stage 2 hypertension range (AHA). A diagnosis needs repeated readings.

diastolic_bp.label: Diastolic blood pressure
diastolic_bp.description: The bottom blood-pressure number, measured between beats. Under 80 is normal, 80–89 stage 1 and 90 or above stage 2 hypertension range (AHA).

heart_rate.label: Resting heart rate
heart_rate.description: Resting beats per minute. 60–100 is the typical adult range; fit people often sit below 60.

cholesterol_total.label: Total cholesterol
cholesterol_total.description: All cholesterol in the blood. Under 200 is desirable, 200–239 borderline high and 240 or above high.

hdl_cholesterol.label: HDL cholesterol
hdl_cholesterol.description: "Good" cholesterol that helps clear other cholesterol. Below 40 (men) or 50 (women) counts as low; 60 or above is protective.

ldl_cholesterol.label: LDL cholesterol
ldl_cholesterol.description: "Bad" cholesterol that builds up in arteries. Under 100 is optimal, 100–129 near optimal, 130–159 borderline high, 160–189 high and 190 or above very high.

triglycerides.label: Triglycerides
triglycerides.description: A type of blood fat. Under 150 is normal, 150–199 borderline high and 200 or above high.

glucose_fasting.label: Fasting glucose
glucose_fasting.description: Blood sugar after at least 8 hours without food. Under 100 is normal, 100–125 is the prediabetes range and 126 or above is the diabetes range (ADA).

glucose_postprandial.label: Glucose after eating
glucose_postprandial.description: Blood sugar about two hours after eating or a glucose drink. Under 140 is normal, 140–199 suggests impaired glucose tolerance and 200 or above is the diabetes range.

insulin_level.label: Insulin
insulin_level.description: Insulin in the blood, usually measured fasting. Higher values can point to insulin resistance. Reference ranges differ between labs, so no bands are shown.

hba1c.label: HbA1c
hba1c.description: Average blood sugar over the past 2–3 months. Below 5.7% is normal, 5.7–6.4% is the prediabetes range and 6.5% or above is the diabetes range (ADA).

diabetes_risk_score.label: Diabetes risk score
diabetes_risk_score.description: A risk score supplied with the dataset; higher means higher estimated risk. How it is calculated is not documented, so treat it as indicative.

diabetes_stage.label: Diabetes stage
diabetes_stage.description: Diabetes status recorded at the checkup.

diagnosed_diabetes.label: Diagnosed diabetes
diagnosed_diabetes.description: Whether the person has been diagnosed with diabetes of any type.

outcomes.label: Diagnosed diabetes
outcomes.description: Diagnosed with diabetes of any type.

outcomes.label: HbA1c 5.7% or higher
outcomes.description: HbA1c in the prediabetes range or above.

outcomes.label: Hypertension
outcomes.description: Has a history of high blood pressure.

outcomes.label: Cardiovascular disease
outcomes.description: Has a history of heart or blood-vessel disease.

outcomes.label: Systolic BP 130 or higher
outcomes.description: Systolic blood pressure in the stage 1 range or above.

outcomes.label: High LDL (160+)
outcomes.description: LDL cholesterol of 160 mg/dL or higher.
